# Taskflow API

## tasks

- [tasks](groups/tasks.md)
- [listTasks](operations/list-tasks.md): Returns every task.
- [createTask](operations/create-task.md): Creates a task.
- [debugTasks](operations/debug-tasks.md): Handles the internal GET /tasks/_debug endpoint.
- [deleteTask](operations/delete-task.md): Permanently removes one task.
- [getTask](operations/get-task.md): Returns one task by its identifier.
- [updateTask](operations/update-task.md): Replaces the mutable fields of one task.

## Schemas

- [AssigneeInput](schemas/assignee-input.md)

- [Status](schemas/status.md)
- [Task](schemas/task.md)
- [TaskList](schemas/task-list.md)
- [UpdateTaskRequest](schemas/update-task-request.md)
